steps.sql: CREATE TABLE cf_resource (uid CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin PRIMARY KEY,repo_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(8) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,path LONGTEXT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,path_hash CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,lifecycle_ref VARCHAR(512) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,description TEXT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 NULL,local_open_type VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NULL,state VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,INDEX resource_location(repo_id,path_hash,kind)) ENGINE=InnoDB
